character: the regime's roof, poured thin to save money: a broken piece HANGS by its rebar, swings, sheds grit, then lets go

strips.layout: column = variant v, row = pair p = ia * 4 + ib (ia, ib = the level index of the start / end vertex)

stages.use: opaque overlay at dmg/thr 25 / 50 / 75 %; variant h32(x, y, 71) % 5; clip to the body

bites.use: one per bullet hit, variant h32(x, y, 80 + salt) % 6, opaque; each hit also plays one dust drip

hang.use: a ceiling hole of 1-2 cells: one piece per removed cell hangs from the hole's UPPER... no: from the LOWER face of the kept roof at the hole's edge (anchor on the lip), variant h32(cx, cy, 95 + salt) % 5; play 0-3 for 2-4 swings (0.6-1.2 s, the hang time), then 4, then 5 and hand the piece (frame 0 minus the bars) to the falling-chunk sim; frame 5 (stubs) stays on the lip for ever. While hanging: a dust drip every 0.3 s from the anchor.

drip.use: from a stage-50+ crack every 0.8-1.6 s (hash), from a hanging piece's anchor every 0.3 s; clip at the first matter

facets.#ff0000: top: the art one ramp step lighter
facets.#00ff00: front: the art as it is

chunks.use: as concrete: a removed cell gives 3-6 chunks cut from its own art, turned by 90s, settling on a 36 deg cone with a 1 px contact shadow

facets.#00ff00: the wall's painted face kept AS IT IS (it reads as a piece of this wall)
facets.#ff0000: the broken top edge: the section, lit

slabs.use: holes of 3+ cells: min(4, 1 + n // 2) slabs, cut from removed cell (i * 3) % n at hashed offsets (keys 64-66), leaning on the wall foot by a shear of one px every 2-3 rows (alternate sides), 1 in 3 stood on end; then the chunks on a 36 deg cone within +-min(32, 10 + 6n) px of the hole centre; grains at the toe

behind: the rock above the roof: the rock painting two steps down with the 3 stepped tones of rock3.paint_back (lit from the hole edge), never a black void
